read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 25% to ₹2,255cr and EBITDA margin 10.8% (vs 10.2%), but FY27 guidance softened to 4–8% growth from 8–12% amid West Asia energy and supply risk; capex ₹130cr held.

capex.quote: more on the INR130 crores than INR140 crores, but we will be in that range. As of now, everything is confirmed.
